description: Verify an A2A payment token (apt_) before doing paid work. Answers validity, amount, caller_did and target_agent_did. The first verify marks the token consumed, and a consumed token answers valid=true again on every later verify: a service agent must remember which payment tokens it has served, or a retry gets the paid work done twice. Requires agent JWT (any agent: the token carries the authority).

expected_target_did.description: Optional: expected target DID for extra check

token.description: The apt_ payment token to verify

name: theprotocol_verifyPayment
title: Verify Payment
